verdict.rationale: Graphite documents custom rules that let teams define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing code (graphite-docs-5). It also offers comment exclusions to suppress unwanted feedback (graphite-docs-20/28), and the pricing page lists 'AI Review customizations' (graphite-docs-33). Together these deliver the core of encoding natural-language team review rules. Missing for 10: evidence of AST/pattern-based rules, linking external style guides, detail on rule syntax and enforcement behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration that rules are actually enforced.
